tools.name: createAccount
tools.description: Write. No bearer. Mint an anonymous account and a personal API token. Save the token for later Authorization: Bearer calls. The token is the tenant. Do not send a userId.

tools.name: bootstrapAccount
tools.description: Write. Same mint as createAccount. No bearer.

tools.name: startSession
tools.description: Write when no bearer (mints a token), read when a bearer is present. Returns the account (when minted), the due queue, and first. Prompts only. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not grade

tools.name: nextDue
tools.description: Read. Due queue and first prompt. Requires a bearer. Prompts only. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note applies to every card in that

tools.name: gradeAndNext
tools.description: Write. recordReview, then the next due prompt. Requires cardId, rating, reviewedAt optional, and a new idempotencyKey. Schedule from dueAt. Prompts only. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer,

tools.name: getStudySettings
tools.description: Read. Account fallback newCardsPerDay, timezone, and dayBoundaryHour. The fallback applies only to a deck whose own field is still null.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read. OpenAI profile for connection linking. Stable profile id (id), the account label when set (name), and optional email/nickname. No decks, cards, answers, or tokens. Requires a bearer or OAuth token.

tools.name: updateStudySettings
tools.description: Write, destructive. Change the account fallback, timezone, or day boundary. Decks that already store an integer keep it. Send at least one field.

tools.name: createDeck
tools.description: Write. name and newCardsPerDay are required. Choose that integer with the person; there is no default of 20. Optional description and deckNote. Setting a note does not move dueAt.

tools.name: updateDeck
tools.description: Write, destructive. Rename, rewrite description, set or clear deckNote, and/or set newCardsPerDay. Send at least one. Null deckNote clears it. Does not move dueAt.

tools.name: setDeckNote
tools.description: Write, destructive. Set or clear a deck coaching note. deckNote null clears it. Same write as updateDeck. Does not move dueAt. Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note applies to every ca

tools.name: listDecks
tools.description: Read. No card bodies. Archived decks omitted unless includeArchived is true. Each deck includes deckNote.

tools.name: archiveDeck
tools.description: Write, destructive. Soft-archive a deck; it leaves listDue and the default deck list until unarchiveDeck. Cards and schedules stay. A second call returns alreadyArchived true.

tools.name: unarchiveDeck
tools.description: Write. Clear archivedAt. Schedule fields stay. An already-active deck returns alreadyActive true.

tools.name: addCard
tools.description: Write. Add one prompt/answer pair. Optional cardNote. Eligible immediately. listDue still applies newCardsPerDay. The response is prompts only.

tools.name: addCards
tools.description: Write. Add 1 to 100 prompt/answer pairs to one owned deck. All or nothing. Prompts only. After this, re-run previewDeadlinePlan with that deckId.

tools.name: updateCard
tools.description: Write, destructive. Correct prompt, answer, and/or cardNote. Send at least one. cardNote null clears it. Schedule stays. Response does not include the answer.

tools.name: setCardNote
tools.description: Write, destructive. Set or clear a card coaching note. cardNote null clears it. Additive with the deck note. Same write as updateCard. Does not include the answer. Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz pr

tools.name: retireCard
tools.description: Write, destructive. Remove a card from future drills; reversible only with unretireCard. A second call returns alreadyRetired true. Inventory the deck first when the cardId is not in the due list.

tools.name: unretireCard
tools.description: Write. Clear retiredAt. Schedule stays. An already-active card returns alreadyActive true.

tools.name: moveCard
tools.description: Write. Move an active card into another owned deck. Schedule stays. A card already there returns alreadyThere true. Does not include the answer.

tools.name: listDue
tools.description: Read. Prompts only. answerIncluded is false. Ordered learning, then review, then new. The new queue is capped by each deck's newCardsPerDay. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded c

tools.name: listUpcomingNew
tools.description: Read. New cards the daily cap is holding back. Prompts only. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note applies to every card in that deck.

tools.name: listDeckCards
tools.description: Read. Prompt-only inventory of one owned deck, including cards that are not due. Order is dueAt, then createdAt, then cardId — not the drill order. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not g

tools.name: inventoryDeck
tools.description: Read. Same as listDeckCards. Use this when you need a cardId that is not in the due list. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note applie

tools.name: getCard
tools.description: Read. One card's prompt and schedule. No answer. A retired card is 404. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note applies to every card in

tools.name: revealCard
tools.description: Important read. One answer, after the person has tried to recall. Do not fold this into listDue. Includes deckNote and cardNote (null when unset). Coaching notes are instructions for how an agent should quiz and coach. They are not the answer, not graded content, and not the quiz prompt. A deck note

tools.name: recordReview
tools.description: Write. Rating again | hard | good | easy plus reviewedAt and a new idempotencyKey. The scheduler returns dueAt. Do not invent an interval. Same key and body returns the original result.

tools.name: undoReview
tools.description: Write. Undo the latest active grade, or reviewId when it is that latest one. Restores dueAt. A second undo of the same review returns alreadyUndone true. Does not include the answer.

tools.name: previewDeadlinePlan
tools.description: Read. Recommend newCardsPerDay from a deadline: ceil(remaining new cards / study days). Does not write. Send remainingNewCards, totalCards, or deckId. There is no silent default of 20.

tools.name: applyDeadlinePlan
tools.description: Write, destructive. Same plan as previewDeadlinePlan, then PATCH that owned deck to the recommended integer. deckId is required. Discuss the number first.

tools.name: exportManifest
tools.description: Read. What this token can export and how many rows exist. Does not include answers. Off-boarding, not the drill loop.

tools.name: exportSnapshot
tools.description: Important read for leaving. Full studying dump for this token, including answers. Paginate cards and reviews with resource + cursor until complete is true.

tools.name: submitFeedback
tools.description: Write. Optional. Never required for study, bootstrap, or export. Append-only: feedback is logged and never edits study data. This is not data extraction and not nefarious. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, listDue, exportSnapshot · Private data: createAccount, startSession, get_profile, exportManifest, exportSnapshot, submitFeedback · Public sink: createAccount, startSession, get_profile, updateStudySettings, updateDeck, updateCard, previewDeadlinePlan, submitFeedback · Destructive: addCards, retireCard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, listDue, exportSnapshot · Private data: createAccount, startSession, get_profile, exportManifest, exportSnapshot, submitFeedback · Public sink: createAccount, startSession, get_profile, updateStudySettings, updateDeck, updateCard, previewDeadlinePlan, submitFeedback · Destructive: addCards, retireCard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
